recorded.how: opencode acp over stdio, on ollama/llama3.2 from a local Ollama

env_set.HOME: a fresh temp folder, with the XDG folders inside it

probe: answers allow_once for paths inside {cwd} and the commands 'echo hi' and 'ls', reject_once otherwise (ask-edit-bash); the first try allowed everything
sanitized: absolute paths of the throwaway repo replaced with {cwd}, the check folder with <live>
note: A first try, kept for what it shows: llama3.2 gave the write tool filePath '/', so OpenCode asked through its external_directory rule first (kind other, title '/', rawInput {filepath, parentDir}) and the probe, which then allowed everything, said allow_once. The write failed reading '/', so the edit rule was never reached, and the recording was made again with the path spelled out. The bash ask ('echo wi', a typo of the model's) came through as in ask-edit-bash.
